translations.welcomeCopy: Colours, sounds, and surprises with every discovery.
translations.highContrastHelp: Boosts the contrast of the chosen mode
translations.vibrationHelp: A little buzz for each key, on devices that support it
translations.kaleidoscopeHelp: Mirrors every effect around the screen
translations.noteColorsHelp: The centre orb always lights up the same colour for the same musical note
translations.parentGateHelp: Hold the top buttons for 2 seconds to open them
translations.screenPinningLink: How to lock the screen for good
translations.screenPinningIntro: The parent gate stops curious taps, but it can't lock the device's own gestures — a swipe or the home button still get out of the app. To really lock it down, use the device's own feature:
translations.screenPinningIosStep1: Settings → Accessibility → Guided Access → turn on
translations.screenPinningIosStep2: With Magic Smash open, triple-click the side button (or the Home button, on older devices)
translations.screenPinningAndroidStep1: Settings → Security → App pinning → turn on
translations.screenPinningAndroidStep2: In recent apps, tap the Magic Smash icon and choose Pin
translations.screenPinningAndroidNote: The exact wording varies a bit from phone to phone.
translations.edgeDeadZoneHelp: Touches right at the screen's edge don't count, for little hands gripping the tablet by its sides
translations.edgeDeadZoneSizeHelp: The bigger it is, the more of the edge gets ignored
translations.palmRejectionHelp: A forearm or palm resting on the screen doesn't count as a tap
translations.iosInstallTip: On an iPhone or iPad, tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen" to install Magic Smash.
translations.profileHelp: This name is saved only on this device.
